title: Automated spot-evals for pinned model upgrades with customer-grade sampling
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Add an automated "spot-eval" runner that triggers when a catalog model or a customer-pinned model is upgraded. The runner should perform lightweight, cost-conscious evaluations against a mix of synthetic and sampled customer traffic (where permitted) to detect quality regressions early and surface actionable signals to customers and SRE/ML teams.
proposal: When a model version is pinned or a catalog model is upgraded, spawn a short-lived eval job that runs: (1) a small fixed set of high-signal synthetic prompts (sanity checks), (2) a stratified sample of recent non-sensitive customer prompts (opt-in/consent required), and (3) topology-aware checks (long-context and multimodal if applicable). Results feed into: API event log, per-customer alerting (if degraded), and internal regression dashboard. The default policy should be conservative (low sample rate, strict PII filtering) and configurable per-tenant and catalog entry.
acceptance_criteria: Spot-eval job is automatically created whenever a model pin changes or a catalog model version is published
Job runs <= 5 minutes and consumes a bounded amount of compute (configurable max GPU-minutes)
Reports include pass/fail per-check, delta metrics vs baseline (latency, avg-token-logprob, Rouge/BLEU where applicable), and a qualitative flag for hallucination-like failures
Per-customer privacy: sampled traffic only used for customers who opted-in (consent recorded), and PII is removed via existing redaction pipeline
Integration tests and an end-to-end demo for a sample customer are available
Documentation for console settings and API webhooks is published
implementation_notes: Leverage existing eval harness from Research: reuse synthetic prompt library and metric collectors
Add a new short-lived job type to the orchestration service with clear resource caps
Implement sampling policy: default 0.1% of recent traffic, configurable per-customer and per-catalog-entry
Integrate redaction stage before any customer data is materialized in evals; log redaction decisions
Emit events to the rollout audit stream so Console can link evals to pin operations
Expose opt-out controls in Console and API for customers to manage sampling consent
rollout_plan: Phase 1: internal-only for catalog model publishes (2 weeks). Phase 2: opt-in beta for 10 enterprise customers (4 weeks). Phase 3: default-on for catalog but opt-in for customer-pinned models with clear consent UI (after privacy review). Backstop: automatic rollback hooks if regression severity exceeds threshold.
